The test image shows a green mango leaf with distinct white/light-colored raised, clustered patches on the surface. These are not brown lesions (ruling out Anthracnose), not dark/black encrustations (ruling out Sooty_Mould), and no twig/bark symptoms (ruling out Die_Back).

The white powdery patches on the leaf surface match Powdery_Mildew. The reference image confirms the white powdery appearance, though the test image shows more concentrated patches — still consistent with the disease.
